evidence_summary: Batch operation with invalid vector (dim 3 vs 4) correctly returns 400 error; count remains 3 before and after failed batch, demonstrating proper atomicity (no partial application)
rationale: The log shows the batch API rejecting invalid input atomically: when one point has wrong dimensions, the entire batch fails and no points are inserted; count stays at 3, proving all-or-nothing behavior rather than the claimed non-atomic partial application
